intuition.title: Core/shell wave-function control
intuition.text: The authors use a CdSe core and CdS shell to separate the spatial distribution of electron and hole wave functions. Their effective-mass calculation predicts a delocalized electron and more core-localized hole. This is source-attributed model interpretation, not a refined atomic structure.

intuition.title: Adsorbate comparisons
intuition.text: MV²⁺ and BQ act as electron-acceptor probes of photoexcited charge dynamics. Their optical signatures and kinetic fits must remain distinct from new particle-size or crystal-phase measurements.

general_background.title: Successive precursor additions
general_background.summary: Successive precursor additions provide a way to control the supply of species used for surface growth. Alternating access to the needed elements can favour addition to existing surfaces, while precursor reactivity and surface accessibility influence incorporation.
